issues.detail: The Greek has three distinct qualities: χρηστότητος (kindness/goodness), ἀνοχῆς (forbearance/tolerance), and μακροθυμίας (patience/longsuffering). The Vietnamese renders the second and third both as 'sự nhịn nhục' (forbearance/patience), collapsing two distinct concepts into one and omitting the distinction between ἀνοχή and μακροθυμία.
